title: LedgerRecord
description: An append-only typed fact. Nothing enters state without provenance and confidence. Corrections are new records that supersede old ones; records are never edited or deleted.

type.description: Record type from the closed type registry.

occurred_at.description: When the fact was true in the world.

recorded_at.description: When we learned it. Bitemporal: both are required to replay a decision as it looked at the time.

origin.description: symbolic = settled/authoritative source. extracted = model-read from unstructured input. derived = computed from other records. human = entered by a person.

source_span.description: Exact location in the source. Required for origin=extracted.

extractor_version.description: Content hash of the model artifact. Required for origin=extracted; needed for replay determinism.

parent_ids.description: Inputs this record was computed from. Required for origin=derived. Provenance is never stripped by aggregation (R-09).

confidence.description: 1.0 permitted ONLY when provenance.origin = symbolic. Model-extracted records are < 1.0 and stay marked forever.

supersedes.description: Correction pointer. The superseded record stays in the store; append-only means a wrong record is corrected, never erased, or replay is a lie.

entries.description: Double-entry lines. Must balance to zero per currency. An action that will not compile to balanced entries cannot be committed at all.

amount.description: Decimal string. NEVER a JSON number: float breaks both the balance identity and determinism (R-05).

body.description: Type-specific payload, validated against the registry entry for `type`.
